subject.title: fix(process): default killProcessTree to true in runCommandWithTimeout

question: Should the documented plugin runtime helper globally change omitted `killProcessTree` behavior even though the linked host-hook report has no verified call path to it?
rationale: Source inspection disproves the proposed host-hook owner path, while accepting the patch would intentionally redefine a public plugin runtime default; repository evidence cannot determine whether maintainers want that compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Require a verified caller
options.body: Retain the existing default and require a production caller-level reproduction before applying tree termination at the owning path.

options.title: Approve the global default
options.body: Treat this as an intentional plugin API behavior change and require compatibility documentation and upgrade coverage for callers that omit the option.

options.title: Close the mismatched fix
options.body: Close this PR if no production command-execution path can be tied to the linked report, and reassess that issue separately.

recommendation.title: Require a verified caller
recommendation.body: Retain the existing default and require a production caller-level reproduction before applying tree termination at the owning path.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest available history ties Daniel Sauer to the introduction and policy of graceful process-tree termination.
